lead: K. Chandrashekar Rao is a widely followed Indian politician, born on 17 February 1954 in Siddipet.
As of 2026, he is 72 years old, and his birth date places him under the Aquarius sign.
He has held the office of Member of the Telangana Legislative Assembly and Member of the 16th Lok Sabha.
Below you will find a verified overview of K. Chandrashekar Rao: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

paras: K. Chandrashekar Rao was born on 17 February 1954 in Siddipet, and holds Indian nationality.

sections.heading: K. Chandrashekar Rao — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician and author as his occupations.

He has held the following offices: Member of the Telangana Legislative Assembly, Member of the 16th Lok Sabha, Minister of Ports, Shipping and Waterways (2004–2004), Minister of Labour and Employment (2004–2006) and Chief Minister of Telangana (2014–2023). He is affiliated with Telugu Desam Party.
